available.quote: Upon recommendation of the allied health advisory board, or upon its own motion, the board may waive the examination, education, or experience requirements and grant a license by endorsement to any applicant who: (1) Presents proof of current registration by the commission on dietetic registration; (2) Presents proof of current licensure to engage in the practice of dietetics in another state or the District of Columbia that requires standards for licensure considered by the board to be equivalent to the requirements for licensure pursuant to this chapter

requirements.value: Proof of current CDR registration, proof of current licensure in another state or DC with equivalent standards, and no disciplinary action by any licensing board, authority, professional association, hospital or institution in any state or district.
requirements.quote: Presents proof of current registration by the commission on dietetic registration; Presents proof of current licensure to engage in the practice of dietetics in another state or the District of Columbia that requires standards for licensure considered by the board to be equivalent to the requirements for licensure pursuant to this chapter; and Does not have any disciplinary action, whether past, pending, public or confidential, by any licensing board, licensing authority, professional association, hospital or institution in any state or district.

exists.quote: "Allied health advisory board" means the Idaho allied health advisory board established pursuant to chapter 1, title 54, Idaho Code.

name.quote: "Allied health advisory board" means the Idaho allied health advisory board established pursuant to chapter 1, title 54, Idaho Code.

authority.value: Makes recommendations to the board on disciplinary actions, licensure by endorsement, and examination recognition; the board of medicine acts upon recommendations of the allied health advisory board.
authority.quote: the board of medicine, upon the recommendation of the allied health advisory board, may issue an order to: (1) Revoke the dietitian's license to practice dietetics; (2) Suspend or restrict the dietitian's license to practice dietetics; and/or (3) Impose conditions or probation upon the dietitian's license to practice dietetics.

national_association.quote: "Academy of nutrition and dietetics" means the national organization that credentials dietetics professionals and accredits undergraduate and graduate programs that prepare dietetics professionals.

definition_quote.value: Dietetics means the integration, application and communication of principles derived from food, nutrition, social, business and basic sciences to achieve and maintain optimal nutrition status of individuals through the development, provision and management of effective food and nutrition services in a variety of settings.
